fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; neutral positioning with earnings in 36 days presents moderate risk and limited conviction indicators.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for PEP; congressional activity is mixed and aged (97+ days), market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (308.64) with imminent NFP event in 2 days creates severe near-term volatility risk; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset; earnings in 36 days adds secondary binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with three white soldiers pattern and RSI(9) at 80.6 confirms strong uptrend structure and momentum continuation potential.
